name: 镇魔英雄谭_The Legend of Demon-slaying Heroes
detailed_description:
The development origin of the game "The Legend of Demon-slaying Heroes".

My two greatest hobbies are playing games and reading novels, and there is a strong connection between these two. Not only are some online novels adapted into games, but some online novels also draw a lot of inspiration from games. Even the content structure of many online novels is similar to that of games.

The structure of many online novels is: a plot occurs, adventure and monster fighting, obtaining materials, refining treasures, cultivation, and then another plot cycle. This is very similar to the game's mode of receiving tasks, dungeon adventures, obtaining resources, alchemy, forging, and receiving higher-level tasks.

The advantage of online novels is that they are easy and refreshing to read, but due to only being able to read, the sense of participation is insufficient. Games require operation, so the sense of participation is stronger than that of online novels. However, many games can be tiring to play because of the tedious leveling up, high difficulty of operation, or complex strategy.

I have always hoped for a game that can enjoy the plot as easily as online novels and also have the sense of participation of games. So I decided to make one myself.

Idle games are considered a relaxed and simple type of game, so I developed the game "The Legend of Demon-slaying Heroes". The characteristic of the game is that it adds main and side missions as plot drivers in idle games.

"The Legend of Demon-slaying Heroes": It is a relaxing idle game that can be enjoyed by playing. The main gameplay of the game is for players to enhance their combat power through brushing dungeons, forging, alchemy, enchanting, running commerce, facility construction, obtaining combat skills, and other means to complete tasks and promote the development of the plot.

Players adventure in the game world like the protagonists of online novels, and because of the interactivity brought by their own operation, this point is more participatory than online novels. At the same time, as an idle game, it can be experienced as easily and refreshingly as reading online novels. There is no monotonous and tedious leveling up, no high difficulty of operation, and no complex strategy.

The game plot is about a young knight named DaTe who was framed. Dart fled to the frontier where monsters are rampant and became a mercenary. He fought monsters here and made brilliant achievements. With the help of the local lord, Dart returned to the royal capital and wanted to find out the truth of his framing and restore his reputation. When he returned to the royal capital, he was involved in the struggle for power among the high-level forces of the empire. Moreover, at this time, the empire is also in a deep crisis, with the human empire, the beastman country, and the elf kingdom on the brink of war, and what is more disturbing is that the demon king KuGeBaEr is about to be resurrected. With the help of Prime Minister BeiKeMan, General FeIDeLiAo, and the female protagonist, Dart defeated the various conspiracies of Prince AiDeMeng and Duke LaSaiEr, and reached peace with the elf country and the beastman country. Then Dart went through various adventures and re-sealed the resurrected demon king. The game has a total of three endings, and different choices made by players in the game can lead to different endings.

Introduction to the main systems of the game:

1. Plot missions: The plot missions in the game not only tell an exciting story but also provide rich rewards, and there are three different endings in the game according to the different choices made by players in the plot. In addition to the main missions, there are also a considerable number of side missions that can provide generous rewards.

2. Dungeons: Players can gain experience and level up through dungeon adventures, which brings growth in abilities and attributes, and strengthens combat power. Monsters in different dungeons have different attributes, and by matching different equipment, potions, and combat skills before the battle (different equipment, potions, and combat skills can be matched before the battle) and choosing strategies during the battle, enemies can be defeated. Materials for alchemy and forging can also be collected in the dungeon.

3. Forging equipment: Upgrade the forging table and obtain higher-level forging materials to create more powerful equipment.

4. Enchanting: Add various attribute damage effects to weapons.

5. Alchemy: Make various potions with different effects through alchemy. The stronger the player's ability, the more dangerous the dungeon they can enter to obtain precious materials to make more powerful potions.

6. Running commerce: A large amount of money is needed in the game for upgrading facilities or training attribute points in the guild, in addition to the rewards obtained through tasks, money can also be earned through running commerce. Players can buy goods in different cities and earn the difference by selling them at a high price.

7. Tavern: In the tavern, you can hear some news or obtain specific tasks with generous rewards.

8. Learning skills: There are also some different NPCs in the game. After improving the friendship with these NPCs in various ways, players can learn powerful combat skills.

9. Attribute points: When the character is upgraded, an attribute point can be obtained, which can be distributed on different attributes (mechanism, perception, agility, charm, enchantment, alchemy, stealth, commerce). In addition, attribute points can also be improved through training in the guilds of various cities. Some of these attribute points can enhance the player's combat power, and some can promote adventure. For example, there are hidden passages or mechanisms in some plots that need to reach a certain perception ability to be discovered. After the player discovers these hidden passages and mechanisms, the plot can be promoted. Or a certain level of stealth is required to avoid the demons guarding key locations in order to promote the development of the plot. The commerce attribute point can increase the money obtained by the player through running commerce. Players can determine their own development route according to their preferences, adopt different gameplay, and obtain game pleasure.

10. Facility construction: Players can also build facilities such as treasuries in the game. After the facilities are built, players can receive a share of the benefits every period of the game process. Different types of facilities can receive different benefits. Facilities can also be upgraded, and the higher the level of the facility, the more benefits can be received each time.

The above only introduces a corner of this colorful game world, and there are many exciting things waiting for you to discover! Enter "The Legend of Demon-slaying Heroes" immediately, and the exciting adventure begins now!
